summary: GreenTree Hospitality Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, reporting its fourth quarter and fiscal year 2025 financial results. The filing contains standard earnings disclosures, including revenue declines and operational metrics for hotels and restaurants. No transaction, strategic review, or special situation is announced. The Form 6-K is a routine report of financial results by a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms or corporate event triggering a special-situation classification.
